name: home-grow-section
replace:
This site grows one town, and one memory, at a time.

New towns are added every week, but the real history doesn't live in archives — it lives with the people who were there. If you know a story, hold a photo, or have your community's history book on a shelf, you can put it where it belongs: on your town's page, with your name on it as the source.

  • Share a memory or correct a date on any town's timeline
  • Share your community's history book — no scanner needed: clear phone photos of the pages work great, or mail us one copy
  • Add your family's people to the town's Cemetery & Remembrance section

Every entry is sourced and credited. This history belongs to the towns — we're just keeping it safe.
